headword: {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}

definitions.explanation: The second level of architect certification in Japan, issued by prefectural governments. Holders are qualified to design smaller buildings, primarily residential structures up to a certain size.

examples.japanese: {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}した→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I obtained my second-class architect license.

examples.japanese: {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A second-class architect can be in charge of designing residences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な{商業施設|しょうぎょうしせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}→一級建築士：29181_ikkyuukenchikushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: For designing large-scale commercial facilities, a first-class architect is required, not a second-class one.

notes:
The lower of the two main architect license levels in Japan (compared to ⟦{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}→一級建築士：29181_ikkyuukenchikushi⟧). The license is issued at the prefectural level, while 一級建築士 is a national license.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: second-class architect examination
- {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}{事務所|じむしょ}: second-class architect firm
- {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: second-class architect qualification
